notes.title: Important fixes
notes.content:
[u][b]Major fixes:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*]Fixed bug where items would not arrive unless orders menu is open
[*]Added a way to reset your tutorial/tool tip progress ("?" in the top right of screen)
[*]Fixed multiple issues with the employee of the month screen
[*]Fixed sizing of the employee of the month screen, buyout screen, and win screen
[/list]


[u][b]Minor fixes:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*]Readded character profiles for customer and employee selections and resume
[*]Removed buildings list upon opening the building menu
[*]Removed ability to select zone 0 when scene is loading
[*]Fixed text that wasn't displaying indoor and outdoor temperatures
[*]Found missing menu button
[*]Changed game settings to start in full screen
[*]Win screen now pauses game
[*]Fixed sizing of the employee bar at bottom of screen
[*]Other more minor fixes
[/list]

[u][b]Possible Fixes[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Made some changes to the garbage collection system, may slightly improve frame rate
[/list]

notes.title: UI update!
notes.content:
It was brought to my attention that the UI does not work for every computer screen, so I spent 30 total work hours redoing the entirety of the game's UI to work on every aspect ratio and resolution. 
It's not perfect and resulted in the creation of a few bugs that I will iron out. Let me know if you experience any new bugs, thank you for playing.

notes.title: V_1.0.2
notes.content:
[u][b]Achievements now work again! [/b][/u](Any achievement progress was saved so once you log back in, you will get everything you have earned).
Reduced the number of traits that are shown to the player (some traits only effect customers and vice versa).
Fixed some misspellings in traits and tutorial messages.
Fixed customer statistics bars being interactable.
Fixed the "-+" on advertising.
Changed some tutorial text to reflect the current state of the game.

Thank you to everyone that informed me of the small bugs that I have overlooked or not tested for. I greatly appreciate it.
I am aware of an issue with the game looking weird on certain monitors and am fixing it now.
